puzzle.hint: This verse reassures believers that hearts find true peace and tranquility through the remembrance (dhikr) of Allah.
puzzle.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
